title: Poverty Definition And Indices
definition: Poverty is a multidimensional state of deprivation encompassing lack of basic necessities of life (income/consumption) and capabilities (health, education, living standards).
importanceInUpsc: Central to GS Paper III (Indian Economy, Inclusive Growth, Human Development) and GS Paper II (Welfare Schemes, Social Justice). Frequently tested via committees (Tendulkar, Rangarajan), global indices (MPI), and conceptual differences (Absolute vs. Relative Poverty).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Poverty Definition And Indices.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
